cohort: The study included 80 antenatal mothers who delivered via cesarean section and their babies, grouped into experimental and control groups.
finding: Early skin-to-skin contact significantly improved breastfeeding status and maternal satisfaction among cesarean section mothers, but showed no significant impact on neonatal adaptation.
mod_finding: Early skin-to-skin contact has a significant positive impact on breastfeeding and maternal satisfaction specifically among mothers who had a cesarean section.
